name: Rifee Dhivehi Comment
author: rifau

sections.description:
Rifee Dhivehi Comment adds a phonetic Dhivehi keyboard to the standard WordPress comment field. Type using Latin keys to enter Thaana characters.

The plugin also applies the bundled Noto Sans Thaana font to the comments area. The font and keyboard are served from your site; the plugin makes no external requests.

Credits

Noto Sans Thaana, Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors, is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The license is included in assets/fonts/OFL.txt. Source: https://github.com/notofonts/thaana and https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansthaana.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the Plugins screen in WordPress, or Upload the rifee-dhivehi-comment folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Rifee Dhivehi Comment from the Plugins menu.
  3. Open a post or page with comments enabled and type in the comment field.
sections.faq:
Does it load fonts from an external service?

No. The font file is bundled with the plugin.

Does it work with every comment form?

The keyboard requires a standard comment textarea with the ID comment. Custom comment forms may not be supported.
